film_facts.title: Unabomber
film_facts.critics_consensus: Playing armchair psychologist to one of America's most infamous killers, Unabomber's fine acting can't compensate for an unconvincing thesis.
film_facts.critics_overview: Robert Daniels of RogerEbert.com gave the film a two out of four stars rating, criticizing its use of tropes from the biopic genre and saying that it felt like a television film. Richard Lawson of The Hollywood Reporter criticized both Crowe's and Tremblay's performances, calling the former "phone[d] in".
